name: VWAP pullback in trend
summary: 15m: in an uptrend over yesterday's close, buy a dip through VWAP that closes above it.

name: VWAP reclaim
summary: 15m: buy a cross back above VWAP with RSI over 50 and ADX over 20; sell on a cross below.

name: Previous-day high break
summary: 15m: buy a break above yesterday's high on high volume; sell below VWAP.

name: Pivot S1 bounce

name: Pivot R1 breakout
summary: 15m: buy a break above pivot R1 over VWAP on high volume; sell below the pivot or above R2.

name: SuperTrend 15m

name: RSI dip in trend
summary: 15m: buy RSI under 35 in an uptrend above yesterday's low; sell when RSI tops 60.

name: Squeeze breakout 15m
summary: 15m: buy the breakout after a Bollinger-in-Keltner squeeze over VWAP; sell below EMA 20.
